q: consumo de electricidad por departamento
note: Demo-brief need. No dataset in the catalogue breaks electricity consumption down by department (no UTE data is published here). The closest genuine answer is the national Balance Energetico Nacional final consumption by source, where electricity is one source line. The per-sector BEN consumption sets carry electricity only inside one sector; MIDES indicators on NBI en electricidad / alumbrado electrico por departamento measure access to electricity, not consumption, and are distractors.
